title: Is Earth Actually Flat?
beats: Kansas flatter than a pancake, then the obvious claim that Earth is round because people would fall off the edge, answered with 'Wrong'
Flat disc Earth with real mass: gravity skews at the rim, so walking to the edge feels like climbing a steeper hill
Runner and buildings in a simulation; stepping over the edge you would roll back toward the centre, a nice level place
The model ignores that a flat disc would collapse into a ball under its own gravity, so the objection was a thought experiment
Pivot: what if gravity isn't real and science is wrong?
Columbus did not discover roundness; the 'people believed flat' myth began as a modern insult
Flat over short distances, curved over long: bridge towers 41 mm further apart at top; Eratosthenes' shadows
Voliva's flat-earth sect in Zion; sun 32 miles across and a few thousand miles away
The Eratosthenes data are reproduced by a near, small sun, so the math works out the same
Modern flat-earthers' ad hoc answers to each piece of evidence, including the conspiracy
Flat Earth Society logo equals the UN projection; are they sincere? Poe's Law
Ad hoc explanations fix one issue only; science prefers the theory that fits more observations
But why privilege our observations? A cosmic-ray proton sees Earth as 17 m thick, flat to it, round to us
Haack's crossword: answers interlock and reinforce, no answer key
1996 NYT Clinton/Dole crossword fit either answer; knowledge may be a puzzle with no key
Feynman quote on living without knowing; sign-off

metrics.key_term: ad hoc explanation / frame of reference
metrics.misconception: yes: opens with the 'obviously round, else we would fall off' belief and overturns it, then the Columbus flat-earth-history myth
metrics.examples: ~6 evidence items (bridge, Eratosthenes, Voliva, flat-earther rebuttals, muon/proton, crossword), roughly flat then escalating in abstraction
metrics.ending: Epistemic humility via crossword and Feynman; no recap or teaser

new_moves.name: steelman-then-pivot
new_moves.what: Build the best case for the absurd position, then show what frame-dependence it reveals
new_moves.evidence: 4:48 flat explanation matches Eratosthenes; 7:01 proton sees flat Earth

new_moves.name: concede-then-undercut-own-trick
new_moves.what: Flags that the disc model is physically impossible right after enjoying it

new_moves.name: abstract-ending-via-concrete-puzzle
new_moves.what: Closes a physics topic on an epistemology analogy told as a small story

theory: Vsauce teaches by taking the 'obvious' answer, granting the contrarian view real charity, and using the collision to expose a deeper structure (underdetermination, frames of reference). Humour and story detours set the idea rate while speech rate stays flat. Understanding is meant as a changed stance toward knowledge, not a procedure.
velocity: Add a steelman/contrarian-model playbook where the tutor simulates a wrong model faithfully before showing where it breaks
Scene builder: support swapping the observer frame (runner, proton) in one simulation to show frame-dependence
Voice: put caveats ('this model ignores...') immediately after a fun toy model to keep honesty
Evals: check that a learner can say why two models fit the same data, not only which is right
quote: I always live without knowing - that is easy.
